reviews.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

Approving `d48e1e22`. Every `detached: true` spawn named in #1747 now drops `detached` on Windows and keeps `windowsHide`, or was already guarded (`runTool`). `spawnDetachedScoreSessions` no longer exists on main. The WMI command line starts the escaped child through `System32\conhost.exe --headless`, as the reporter suggested. On macOS, a built CLI on this head behaves the same as the merge-base and current main: the background dispatcher is still detached, with its own process group.

Not verified by anyone here: the window count on a real Windows Terminal. Our check stubbed `process.platform` and PowerShell. That shows the conhost command line and `detached: false` with `windowsHide: true` on every Windows spawn, but it cannot show that no window opens. @wstczyw, if you can, please confirm on your Windows 11 / Windows Terminal setup once this lands.

Non-blocking:
- [P3 nit] `src/hook-dispatch-cli.ts:227` still says `ShowWindow = 0` hides the new console at creation, which the new comment at :266 contradicts. Worth a one-line update.
- [P3 nit] The new `CHANGELOG.md` line is followed by a blank line that splits the Bug Fixes list.
- [P3 nit] `hook-dispatch-cli.test.ts` is not in the Windows CI test list, so the new Windows assertions run only with a stubbed platform.

The CI review (https://github.com/Tencent/teamai-cli/pull/1761#issuecomment-6681162884) reports no findings and treats the missing Windows run as non-blocking. We agree. CI is green at this head, including the Windows job.
